_comment: Configuration for tools/market-intelligence.mjs — the daily European market scan.
WHAT THIS FILE IS FOR
Everything the scan decides with lives here rather than in the generator: the
query pools per market, how much a source is trusted, how a candidate is
scored, and the thresholds that turn a score into an action. An argument about
what the engine publishes is therefore an argument about this file.
THE RULE THE WHOLE ENGINE RUNS ON
The engine may not invent. Not a municipality, not a project, not a permit,
not a price, not a contact, and above all not a source URL. When there is
nothing real to publish it records NO_PUBLISH and publishes nothing. A day
with no news is a normal day; a day with invented news is a broken site.
SEARCH IS NOT CONFIGURED BY DEFAULT
There is no search API key in this repository and there must not be one — the
standing rule is that no secret is committed. Without MODUNERA_SEARCH_PROVIDER
and its key in the environment, the scan runs, finds nothing, and reports
NO_PUBLISH with the reason 'provider not configured'. That is the honest
failure mode, and it is loud rather than silent.
QUERIES ARE PER MARKET AND PER LANGUAGE
A German municipal signal is not found by searching in English. Each market
carries its own terms in its own language, which is also why the results are
worth having.

run.schedule_note: 04:35 UTC is 07:35 Europe/Istanbul. Istanbul is UTC+3 all year, so this does not drift with daylight saving. It runs before the daily post at 05:12 UTC on purpose: the scan may add a news item, and the post run should pick it up in the same morning rather than the next one. It is not on the hour because GitHub schedules cluster at :00 and are delayed there most.

markets.name: Schweiz / Suisse
queries: Tiny House Ferienanlage Tourismus Gemeinde Schweiz
tiny house commune permis de construire Suisse

source_authority.note: Municipality, canton, national government, official planning or participation portal, procurement portal, EU institution.
Reputable national or regional media, architecture and construction trade press, professional associations.
Everything not matched above. Usable as a lead to an official source, never as the source itself.

blocked_as_primary_source.note: Never accepted as the source of a regulation, permit or project status. May be used to find the official source, which is then cited instead.

scoring.note: Section 27 of the master prompt. A candidate is only considered for publication above publish_threshold.

quality_gate.note: Section 55. Checked before anything is written, not after.

commercial_signals.note: Section 28. These raise the commercial opportunity score because they are the developments that turn into an enquiry.

status_taxonomy.note: Section 23. Assigned only from a verified source; anything else is UNKNOWN.

decision.note: Section 18. Creating a new URL is deliberately the last option, not the default.
decision.location_pages_note: Section 19. 14,641 programmatic location pages already exist and are held out of the sitemap by data/location-index-policy.json. The engine may never add one. A place-specific finding updates the existing page for that place or becomes a news item; it does not mint a URL.
decision.cannibalisation_note: Section 39. A candidate whose title overlaps an existing indexed page above this is routed to UPDATE, never to CREATE.

auto_publish.note: Section 65. Read from the environment at run time; these are the defaults when unset.
auto_publish.why: Every default is false. A regulation or permit statement that reaches this site without a person reading it first is the one failure this project cannot absorb, and the site already carries the reputation of being the careful supplier.
